verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of GitLab's Package Registry or support for multiple package formats (npm, Maven, PyPI, Docker, etc.) that would let a maintainer publish and consume packages across formats from one platform; all citations focus on CI/CD, security scanning, AI agents, and integrations. missing for 10: any documentation of the Package Registry, supported package formats, publish/consume workflows, or package-registry API endpoints.
